description: HIGH GARDEN Rooftop is the capital’s trendiest hot spot that serves a daily authentic Levantine and international breakfast & brunch, lunch and dinner menu. HIGH GARDEN Rooftop offers an array of beautifully crafted cocktails using natural and fresh ingredients, as well as comprehensive wine and beer lists that perfectly pair with the à la carte menu. The service and hospitality at Il Terrazzo are very unique, coming straight from the heart. What's more, we offer a range of dining options to cater to all our guests' needs, including gluten-free options for those with dietary preferences or restrictions. It's not just a meal; it's an experience of Italian culinary excellence, served with seasonal ingredients to savor the freshest flavors.

name: Eostrix Gastro Pub
description: Here’s how you pronounce our name: Yo – Strix. Now memorize it, because you’ll be saying it quite often. We called ourselves after a lucky creature of the night; a breed of owls that are known to be a good luck charm in ancient civilizations. Eostrix was founded because we wanted to offer something different to the local scene, away from the standard bar menu and unified playlists across most nightlife spots. We wanted to create a food and beverage experience that was unique and pleasant. We are a gastropub that has a neighborhood cozy feel, serves mixologist signature drinks, cocktails and a unique fusion menu that puts fuel in gastro. A space designed to cater to groups and individuals in a bar stool or lounge seating, pick what makes you the most comfortable and kick back.

description: Step into the extraordinary world of Néos Sunset Rooftop, where the city bows to the setting sun. Perched in the heart of Amman with an awe-inspiring panoramic view of the cityscape, featuring an ambiance adorned with lush bamboo interiors, Néos will transport you to a world of paradisiacal experience as the sun gracefully paints the sky in vibrant hues, offering a front-row seat to nature's masterpiece—the mesmerizing sunset. Our epicurean chefs at Néos passionately curate a menu that blends the finest in modern gastronomy with the art of fusion cuisine from the Mediterranean and other timeless traditions from around the world. Our masterful mixologists embrace an infusion philosophy, creating beverage and wine menus that are lavishly ideal for celebrating life's milestones, savoring romantic evenings against a mesmerizing backdrop, or enjoying convivial hangouts with friends or colleagues. Experience the enchanting Néos Sunset Rooftop and embark on a culinary adventure.
